resolutionEvidence.quote: In the capacity notice reviewed on October 27, 2026, reserved campers are admitted during capacity closures; day visitors, including pedestrians and cyclists, are excluded. This exception does not override an emergency closure. Confirm current park status before using these instructions.
resolutionEvidence.judgment: The capacity rule now explicitly admits reserved campers and excludes day visitors including pedestrians and cyclists. It is dated by review and immediately bounded by emergency-closure and current-status instructions. The source disclosure retains the notice effective date. The normal pre-5 p.m. contact requirement for after-sunset arrival still applies only once overnight operations are confirmed.
